transient_patch.new:
def set_vqd(query: str | int, value: str, params: "OnlineParams") -> None:
    """Dot modification, 2026-10-13: do not retain query-derived VQD tokens.

    The owned Dot gateway supports page one only; cached VQD is used solely by
    later-page requests, which that gateway rejects before engine dispatch.
    This source delta must accompany the exact corresponding SearXNG source.
    """
    return None
transient_patch.old:
def set_vqd(query: str | int, value: str, params: "OnlineParams") -> None:
    cache = get_cache()
    key = cache.secret_hash(f"{query}//{params['headers']['User-Agent']}")
    cache.set(key=key, value=value, expire=3600)
